description: Publish a pending spec submission so it becomes the initiative's active ICE spec, exactly as it was submitted. ONLY call this when the user has read that submission (show it from anyforge_get_initiative_spec `pendingSubmission`) and explicitly asked you to publish it; never publish a spec you proposed on your own judgement. The Architect plans the whole backlog from the active spec. Pass the `submissionId` the user reviewed. Works only for a person connected through OAuth (the hosted MCP) with the `approve` scope and a role that edits initiatives; a Control API key gets 403 spec_publish_requires_person. Refused with 409 spec_version_conflict when the active spec changed after the submission, and spec_publish_needs_console_review when publishing would add the initiative's intake notes to Context (in both cases the person reviews it in the Console instead), and spec_submission_not_pending when a newer submission replaced it or it was rejected. An already published submission answers status "already_published" and changes nothing. To accept or reject single sections, use the returned reviewUrl in the Console.

submissionId.description: The pending submission to publish: `pendingSubmission.id` from anyforge_get_initiative_spec.
